subject.title: fix(gateway): recover when suppressed channel secrets are unavailable

question: While crash-loop suppression is active, should a successful `secrets.reload` automatically restart channel accounts that were running, or must all channel activation remain behind an explicit `channels.start` request?
rationale: Current main documents and implements a fail-safe no-automatic-restart contract, while this PR intentionally replaces it with selective account restarts; tests cannot determine which operator-facing recovery policy maintainers want.

options.title: Preserve Explicit Recovery
options.body: Narrow this PR to startup source/assignment projection and keep all safe-mode channel activation behind explicit `channels.start`.

options.title: Adopt Selective Restarts
options.body: Approve automatic restart of previously running accounts and require exact-head supervised proof for running, stopped, timeout, rollback, and retry cases.

options.title: Choose Competing Candidate
options.body: Select https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/106405 as the canonical implementation after confirming its current head preserves the chosen recovery contract.

recommendation.title: Preserve Explicit Recovery
recommendation.body: Narrow this PR to startup source/assignment projection and keep all safe-mode channel activation behind explicit `channels.start`.

likelyOwner.reason: The history ties this person most directly to the crash-loop breaker and its intended channel-suppression semantics.
